screenplay_source.heading: INT. ANAADHI’S RAISED CABIN – CONTINUOUS
screenplay_source.beat_summary: Aarathi enters the already-breached cabin, challenges the unexplained sedative and tries to re-establish direct trust with sedated Anaadhi. His perception fractures into five mutually exclusive Parallel Aarathi variants before RST01 restores the real, unarmed Aarathi. She admits giving the operation his location but rejects the chemical assault; Anaadhi closes his eyes.
screenplay_source.end_boundary: Anaadhi closes his eyes; SC004 begins only after this package ends.
